trap.label: sobre
trap.wrong: This paper explores about the link between sleep and memory.
trap.right: This paper explores the link between sleep and memory.
trap.why: Em português “falar/explorar sobre” leva o aluno a acrescentar about. Em inglês, examine e explore são transitivos.

fix.wrong: The paper discusses about a third variable.
fix.right: The paper discusses a third variable.

fix.wrong: Using trials, the paper show effects.
fix.right: Using trials, the paper shows effects.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com examines: “This paper talks about the design.”
Reescreva com suggest: “Findings show a clear link.” (suggest)
Reescreva com We argue that: “Our view is that the design is flawed.”
rewrite.answer: We argue that the design is flawed.
